blocks.text: Mako is the session notification daemon. The Waybar notification menu opens the notification center, changes Do Not Disturb, restores a notification or clears history. Clearing history removes the notification record; it does not undo the application action.

Supported notification colors and presentation are available in Desktop Appearance. The native configuration is ~/.config/mako/config. Keep one notification daemon; running another can replace the D-Bus notification owner.

Check quiet mode, then use Computer Management → System & Recovery → Maintenance & Health → Audio & Desktop → Test Mako Notification. A test notification verifies display at that moment; it does not prove a reminder was scheduled.
